decisions.why: System C's Healthcare division, read from systemc.com's own XML sitemap under its /healthcare/ path. The six items in this bucket are CareFlow EPR, ChemoCare, BadgerNet Maternity, BadgerNet Neonatal, CarePlus Child Health and Bespoke Software Development — every one a named clinical or departmental software system, matching the digital:sw description 'clinical and departmental software systems (imaging, oncology, laboratory and asset-tracking)'. The company's own Healthcare page lists exactly this set under the heading 'Healthcare' and describes the business as providing 'healthcare software... the next generation of hospital IT' (systemc.com/healthcare/, read 05/09/2026). The clinical-area names here (Maternity, Neonatal, Child Health, Oncology via ChemoCare) are that company's software FOR those departments, not devices sold into them, so none is filed against its clinical speciality — the same reading already accepted for HD Clinical Ltd and Sectra Limited. THIS IS THE HEALTHCARE DIVISION, NOT THE WHOLE COMPANY: System C's site carries a second, separately-navigated division, Local Government (the five Liquidlogic adults/children's/education social care case management, social care finance and commissioning products), which was deliberately not captured — local-authority social care case management is not clinical or departmental hospital software and has no home in the current digital vocabulary. Its two AI pages (CareFlow Ambient AI - Outpatients, Liquidlogic AI) were likewise left out, one being clinical and one social care under a single /ai-at-system-c/ path that cannot be split by division. So this range is System C's clinical software range as the company itself groups it, not its complete product list. System C Healthcare Ltd (Stratford-Upon-Avon) is a named awarded contractor on this framework's own contract award notice (Find a Tender 2025/S 000-043444, NHS Supply Chain, Digital Diagnostic Solutions, 54 contractors).

System C's own sub-grouping under its Healthcare division, read from the nested /healthcare/careflow-medicines-management/ path on systemc.com: CareFlow EPMA (electronic prescribing and medicines administration) and CareFlow Pharmacy. Both are hospital departmental software systems and sit under the same Healthcare heading on the company's own navigation, so both file to digital:sw for the same reason as the division above. The CareFlow Medicines Management landing page itself was dropped by the crawler's prefix test as a page you pass through rather than a product.
